na mo gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī yai/gsur mchod mdor bsdus gtang bar spro na/zas sna myang grol dam rdzas bsres pa bsregs la chab bran/skyabs sems bya/rang

tei:div.tei:p: na mo gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī yai/ gsur mchod mdor bsdus gtang bar spro na/ zas sna myang grol dam rdzas bsres pa bsregs la chab bran/ skyabs sems bya/ rang nyid thugs rje chen por gyur: bsreg rdzas oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum las: ye shes mchod sbyin 'phro bar bsam: bslu med dkon mchog gsum rnams la: bsreg rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul: bdag dang sems can bskyab tu gsol: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la: bsreg rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul: bdag dang sems can byin gyis rlobs: chos skyong yul lha gzhi bdag la: bsreg rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul: bar chad sol la phrin las sgrubs: pha mas gtsor byas sems can la: bsreg rdzas bdud rtsi 'di bsngos pas: sgrib dag tshogs gnyis rdzogs par shog: bar dor gnas pa'i sems can la: bsreg rdzas bdud rtsi 'di bsngos pas: 'khrul snang sdug bsngal zhi bar shog: lan chags dgra bgegs thams cad la: bsreg rdzas bdud rtsi 'di bsngos pas: bu lon sha 'khon byang bar shog: sngon gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyis: sbyin pas don rnams grub pa bzhin: chos nyid rnam dag bden pa yis: smon lam thams cad 'grub par shog: ༈ dgong mo'i char dmar gsur spro na/ sha khrag phye phur sbyar ba bsregs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ sambha ra lan gsum gyis bsngo/ oṃ sha khrag 'bru sman sbyar pa yi: gsur mchod 'dod yon lnga ldan 'di: bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi: tshe dang srog la bar gcod pa'i: 'chi bdag gshin rje ma mo'i sde: 'byung po sha za gnod sbyin tshogs: srin po dri za yi dwags sogs: ma rungs gdug pa'i sems 'chang ba: 'khor dang bcas pa kun la bsngo: dgyes shing mnyes nas rab tshims te: bu lon lan chags byang ba dang: khros shing 'khrugs pa'i sems kun zhi: dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa dang: nad dang gnod pa kun las thar: phan dang bde ba'i sems skyes nas: bkra shis phun sum tshogs par shog:
ces dang 'grub na chos sbyin dang bsngo smon bya'o// zhes mchog gling gter byon thugs chen dang thugs sgrub las khol du phyung ba dge legs 'phel/// /
